In this case, even the function bodies are safe and standard, using common build patterns like `cmake` and `ninja`. There are no top-level side effects such as background downloads, data exfiltration, or use of `eval`, `curl`, or `base64`.

Thus, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this file is safe, as it will only parse metadata without executing harmful code.
</details>
